g.text: Network safety: one policy, two paths, defense in depth

What never happens: a redirect or link to another host is followed (it is recorded as out of scope); a bot challenge or
rate limit is evaded (it is recorded as blocked); a probe or tool sends a POST (writes need an explicit flag, and even then
only search or filter forms without sensitive fields); a credential WebMorph observed is replayed on its own authority (D21, D23).
Evidence is redacted at capture: sensitive query values replaced, request bodies never stored (JSON shapes only),
cookie and credential headers recorded by name, never by value.
